title: Digital Marketing Executive (Social Media)
description:
FindCore are thrilled to be assisting a leading not-for-profit organisation with the recruitment of a Marketing Executive (Social Media & Content).

The role will be based in Cheadle, Greater Manchester, and will focus on growing organic reach, engagement and income across the organisation's established social media channels.

Salary

£35,000 - £45,000, depending on experience + great benefits.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop engaging social media content across a range of established platforms.
- Help grow organic reach, engagement and income through social media activity.
- Plan and deliver content aligned with wider marketing and fundraising objectives.
- Manage content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and X.
- Create and adapt content including short-form video, social copy and campaign assets.
- Monitor performance and use analytics to improve future content and campaigns.
- Support paid social activity where required.
- Work closely with wider digital and fundraising teams on integrated campaigns.
- Identify emerging social media trends and opportunities to grow audiences.
- Use AI and digital tools to support content creation, reporting and campaign development.

Skills & Experience
- 2+ years' experience within social media, content marketing or digital marketing.
- Proven experience growing social media reach and engagement.
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills.
- Good understanding of social media analytics and performance reporting.
- Experience with paid social, SEO or creator content would be beneficial.
- Comfortable using AI-powered content tools as part of the creative process.
- Strong communication, organisation and project-management skills.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £35,000 - £45,000 depending on experience.
- Opportunity to join a purpose-led not-for-profit organisation.
- Varied role combining social media, content creation and digital marketing.
- Opportunity to work across large-scale digital and fundraising campaigns.
- Cheadle-based position.

For further information on this opportunity, or any other jobs, please apply via the link below or contact FindCore in the strictest confidence.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Stockport £45,000-£55,000 + Bonus

We are working with an established and successful B2 B finance business in Stockport to recruit a Marketing Manager to take full ownership of its marketing activity.

This is a standalone, hands-on marketing role offering genuine autonomy and the opportunity to shape how an established SME approaches marketing.

Working directly with the directors and alongside the sales team, you'll be responsible for developing the marketing plan and, importantly, making it happen.

The role is deliberately broad, covering digital marketing, traditional media, content, video, events, sales collateral and communications.

You won't be expected to be an expert in every discipline. The business is happy to invest in external agencies and specialist third parties where appropriate. What we're looking for is someone who can see the bigger picture, identify what needs doing and take responsibility for getting it delivered.

The Role

You'll take ownership of marketing across the business, from strategy and planning through to hands-on delivery.
- Developing and owning the company's marketing plan and budget.
- Planning and delivering campaigns to increase brand awareness, generate opportunities and support business growth.
- Managing digital activity across the website, social media, email and other relevant channels.
- Creating and coordinating engaging content for both digital and traditional marketing.
- Developing high-quality sales brochures, presentations, case studies and other collateral.
- Managing press, PR and traditional advertising opportunities.
- Developing video content and coordinating external production where required.
- Planning and supporting exhibitions, events and other face-to-face marketing activity.
- Working closely with the sales team to develop campaigns and materials that support business development.
- Ensuring consistency of brand, messaging and tone of voice across the business.
- Measuring marketing performance and using the results to continually improve activity and investment.
- Selecting, briefing and managing external agencies, freelancers and specialist suppliers where appropriate.

About You

We're looking for a broad, commercially minded marketer rather than a narrow specialist.

You'll be comfortable operating in an SME environment where priorities can change, people work closely together and good ideas don't need to pass through multiple layers of management before they happen.

You'll be equally comfortable discussing strategy with the directors and rolling your sleeves up to deliver a campaign, improve a presentation, organise an event or create a piece of content.

You'll ideally bring:
- Broad experience across digital and traditional marketing.
- Strong written communication and content skills.
- An understanding of B2 B marketing and how marketing can support a sales function.
- Good project management and organisational skills.
- Commercial awareness and an ability to measure the effectiveness of marketing activity.
- Confidence working independently and taking responsibility for decisions.
- The ability to manage external agencies and suppliers effectively.
- Creativity, curiosity and the confidence to introduce new ideas.

Previous experience in financial services or another B2 B environment would be advantageous but isn't essential.

More important is your ability to take ownership.

The Opportunity

For the right person, this is a chance to make a marketing function your own.

You'll have direct access to the company's decision-makers, a close relationship with the sales team and the freedom to influence where marketing investment is made.

The business recognises that one person cannot be a specialist in every area of modern marketing, so you'll have the ability to outsource specialist work to trusted third parties where it makes sense.

If you're currently working in a larger marketing team and feel ready to step up and take ownership, or you're already operating independently within an SME and want greater autonomy, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Salary: £45,000-£55,000 + bonus

Location: Stockport

Full-time Permanent

title: Paid Marketing Executive
description:
Paid Marketing Executive

Altrincham Office-based £40,000-£45,000

Zachary Daniels are excited to be partnering with a fast-growing premium retail brand to recruit a Paid Marketing Executive as the business continues to expand its digital presence across both the UK and US.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a hands-on paid media specialist who wants genuine ownership. You'll take responsibility for planning, delivering and optimising paid activity across Google and Meta, managing meaningful budgets and playing a key role in driving profitable eCommerce growth.

You'll be in the platforms, making decisions, testing campaigns and using performance data to continually improve results.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Owning paid media activity across Google Ads and Meta in the UK and US
- Managing budgets, spend pacing and reallocating investment based on performance
- Building and optimising Search, Shopping, Performance Max, remarketing and paid social campaigns
- Managing Google Merchant Centre, product feeds and campaign segmentation
- Running structured testing across creative, audiences, messaging and campaign structure
- Analysing ROAS, CPA, conversion, revenue and customer acquisition performance
- Working closely with eCommerce, Buying, Product and Finance teams
- Turning performance data into clear commercial recommendations

We're looking for someone with proven hands-on paid search and paid social experience, ideally gained within eCommerce, retail or a commercially focused team environment.

You'll be confident across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics and Google Merchant Centre, with a strong understanding of metrics including ROAS, CPA, AOV and conversion.

Experience with Shopify, product feeds, Google Tag Manager or international campaigns would be a real advantage.

Most importantly, you'll be analytical, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership of a channel where your decisions have a direct impact on business performance.

This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious premium retailer where you'll have real autonomy, visibility and the chance to make a measurable impact.

Apply today or contact Zachary Daniels for more information.
